steps.title: Tuning
steps.text: The tune is the heart of the build. Your tune is custom written for your truck and the parts you choose below. Run it on EZ LYNK, or pick the SCT / Bully Dog tune if you already own one of those tuners.

options.name: EZ LYNK Custom Tuning Support Package
options.note: Limited support gives 4 weeks of tune access. Full support lasts as long as AMDP supports the truck.

options.name: SCT / Bully Dog Custom Tuning
options.note: For your own SCT or Bully Dog tuner. Choose a level or the 5 tune package.

steps.title: Tuning Device
steps.text: The device loads your tune onto the truck. Already have one? Skip this step. Only needed for the EZ LYNK tune.

steps.title: Delete Pipe
steps.text: The pipe that replaces the factory DPF section. Optional.
